reason: I already have an inverter and battery in the house. A plain semi-automatic washer costs about half this, and if I plug it into the inverter it keeps going through the cut, so why pay ₹22,000 for a second battery inside the machine?
objection: I'd be paying twice for backup. The battery only does two cold loads, and in a few years it will need replacing, while my inverter battery already does the job and runs the fans and lights too.
would_change_my_mind: If the dealer showed me my inverter really can't take the washer's motor load, and the price came down close to a normal semi-automatic plus a little extra, maybe ₹15,000 to ₹16,000.
